note: What a server shows a font with when it does not have it (E3.13, D905). The one source of these facts: claudia_fonts reads it, the server sends it with GET /api/fonts, and scripts/generate_font_stand_ins.py writes the layout library's copy. generics: the font each CSS generic family stands for, and the last resort (fallback). same_widths: open fonts that take exactly the room of a common office font, so lines and pages break as in the original; every one of them is in the shipped starter set. A font is only stood in for when the server does not have it.
